topic: Cleaning duplicate VA data in frame_va
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on data quality issues within the `frame_va` table. [me] noted that while new VA uploads with coordinates are an improvement, duplicate records still exist.

[me] provided a SQL query to identify duplicates based on `(frame_id, road_id, transport_type)`.

[me] proposed removing the duplicates by keeping only the row with the maximum `va` value. [p1] agreed not to proceed with this cleanup immediately but stated they would investigate the source and nature of the duplication later.
decisions: The plan to remove duplicate records from `frame_va` using `max(va)` was postponed.
action_items: [p1] will investigate the source and cause of the VA data duplication.
